text:
Predicates:
Monday(t) ::: t is a Monday.
Time8pm(t) ::: t is 8 pm.
RoseGiven(t) ::: roses are given out on TV at time t.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad show.

Premises:
∃t (Monday(t) ∧ Time8pm(t) ∧ RoseGiven(t)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀t (RoseGiven(t) → OnBachelor(t)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
∀t (RoseGiven(t) ∧ ¬OnBachelor(BreakingBad) → (Monday(t) ∧ Time8pm(t))) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
